props.name: color
props.description: The full-level fill; any CSS color.

props.name: rows
props.description: Fill column by column, this many cells tall. Wins over `columns`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Fill row by row, this many cells wide. Defaults to 10 when `rows` is unset.

props.name: levels
props.description: Steps on the color ramp, counting the empty level 0.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Makes cells selectable without controlling the value.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: The cell under the pointer or focus, or null when it leaves.
